title: 第17章 另类模式第18章 悲喜不同
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
寒门书楼里面的这些读书之人，绝大多数都是要走科考一途的！
这不想走科考道路的，自然也就成为了另类。
这些人人数稀少，他们所做的事情，也就在书楼上下广为流传！
林铭就属于这么一个另类，从进入书楼到现在为止，他所看的就是历史类的书籍，每天半个时辰，雷打不动，到时间就走！
在寒门书楼之中，也成为了一个奇人！
“王小哥说的是！”
林铭笑着回道：
“接下来我会努力！”
说话之间，他人也已然是进入到了书楼之中，熟练的在书架之中找到了他只看了一半的《国朝·真宗史》，带着书籍来到了何掌柜的面前。
他还没有将书放上去，何掌柜已经带着笑容的说道：
“林小哥，还是《真宗史》？！”
“对！”
林铭从《太祖史》开始看起来，一步步向下，每天都是接着前一天在看！
何掌柜对林铭所看的书籍也大概有数，不用林铭说，他也知道林铭还应该继续看《真宗史》。
刷刷！
何掌柜给林铭进行了登记！
“好了！”
他说完之后，正常林铭就应该上楼去看书了。
可今天林铭却并没有第一时间拿着书本上楼，依旧站在何掌柜的面前。
“还有事？！”

何掌柜有些意外的看着林铭。
林铭点了点头，直接说道：
“何掌柜，我确实还有一点事情想要询问一下，咱们书楼出书么？！”
“出书？！”
何掌柜眼神之中带着一丝奇怪的看着林铭！
一看他的神色，林铭就知道何掌柜误会了，赶紧补充着：
“何掌柜不要误会，我也知道我并不是什么大儒，那种高高在上的书籍，我是写不来的，我说的是评书，我们书楼出不？！”
“评书？！”
何掌柜有些意外的赞同一句！
“想不到林小哥这般有才。”
赞叹完毕，何掌柜继续说道：
“评书，我们书楼自然是收的，只是却要先看看书稿的质量……”
“明白！”
林铭立刻点头，从怀中拿出了《白眉大侠》第一册的书籍，递给了何掌柜。
“何掌柜，这是我写的评书的第一册，这样，您先看着，我上楼继续去看书，一会我看完了书，下来，您要是觉得我写得还可以，还能入得了你的眼，那我们就继续聊聊；要是我写的不行，入不了您的眼，您也不用多说什么？！等我还书的时候，将这书本放到我的手边，我自然就会将其收走，不会再打扰掌柜的……”
“好！”
何掌柜也将林铭的《白眉大侠》打开，开始查看了起来。
林铭这边拿着《真宗史》上了三楼！
今天三楼看书的人比较多！
几乎已经占满了所有的书桌，只有田文陈所坐的书桌还有位置！
content_en:
Most of the people studying in the humble library want to take the scientific examination!
Those who don’t want to take the path of scientific examination naturally become an alternative.
These people are few in number, and what they do is widely circulated in the library!
Lin Ming is such an alternative. From the moment he entered the library until now, all he has read are historical books. He spends half an hour every day, and he will leave when the time comes!
In the humble library, he also became a strange person!
"Brother Wang said yes!"
Lin Ming smiled and replied:
"I will work hard next!"
While he was talking, others had already entered the library. He skillfully found the "History of Guochao·Zhenzong" that he had only read half of on the bookshelf, and brought the book to Shopkeeper He.
Before he put the book on it, shopkeeper He said with a smile:
"Brother Lin, or "History of Zhenzong"?!"
"Yes!"
Lin Ming started reading "History of Taizu" and went down step by step. Every day he continued to read it from the previous day!
Shopkeeper He also had a rough idea of ​​the books Lin Ming had read. He didn't need Lin Ming to tell him, but he also knew that Lin Ming should continue reading "History of Zhen Zong".
Swish!
Shopkeeper He registered Lin Ming!
"Okay!"
After he finished speaking, Lin Ming would normally go upstairs and read a book.
But today, Lin Ming did not immediately go upstairs with the book, but still stood in front of Shopkeeper He.
"Is there anything else?!"
Shopkeeper He looked at Lin Ming with some surprise.
Lin Ming nodded and said directly:
"Shopkeeper He, I do have something else I want to ask. Does our library publish books?!"
"Publish a book?!"
Shopkeeper He looked at Lin Ming with a hint of strangeness in his eyes!
One look at his expression, Lin Ming knew that Shopkeeper He had misunderstood, and quickly added:
"Don't get me wrong, Shopkeeper He. I also know that I'm not a great scholar. I can't write such lofty books. What I'm talking about is storytelling. Can our library produce it?!"
"Storytelling?!"
Shopkeeper He unexpectedly agreed!
"I didn't expect Brother Lin to be so talented."
After praising him, Shopkeeper He continued:
"Our library naturally accepts storytelling, but we have to check the quality of the manuscript first..."
"Understood!"
Lin Ming nodded immediately, took out the first volume of "White Eyebrow Hero" from his arms, and handed it to Shopkeeper He.
"Shopkeeper He, this is the first volume of storytelling that I wrote. So, you read it first. I will go upstairs and continue reading. After a while, I will finish reading the book. When I come down, if you think my writing is good and it can catch your eye, then we will continue to chat; if my writing is not good and I can't catch your eye, you don't need to say anything?! When I return the book, put this book in my hand and I will naturally take it away and won't disturb the shopkeeper anymore..."
"Okay!"
Shopkeeper He also opened Lin Ming's "White Eyebrow Hero" and began to check it.
Lin Ming took the "History of Zhenzong" and went up to the third floor!
There are more people reading on the third floor today!
Almost all the desks have been occupied, and only the desk where Tian Wenchen is sitting still has room!
